character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Full-body standing idle sprite of a newly graduated young ADULT female Chinese language teacher, about 24 years old. Clearly an adult teacher, friendly confident face, golden blonde shoulder-length hair. Wearing a simple pale sky-blue blouse, a clearly WHITE PLEATED SKIRT with visible vertical pleats, and dark brown boots rising to the lower calf. The golden hair, white pleated skirt and boots are the defining details. Professional everyday school-teacher outfit, neutral pose, empty hands by her sides. Match the supplied student's retro pixel-art style, restrained small palette, crisp single-pixel outlines and simple shading, same pixel density and in-game scale. Slight overhead low top-down orthographic view showing a little of the head top, no perspective shrinking. Centered south-facing full-body neutral standing pose, both feet grounded at the same level. Native 32 by 48 transparent canvas, aim for visible height 40 pixels, leave about 4 pixels under the feet and headroom above. No scenery, no floor, no lettering, no watermark, no blurry antialiasing, no cast shadow.
